# KosCMS Database Issues — Settings Not Persisting
> 
> These bugs were found while debugging why admin/settings changes report success but revert on page refresh.
> 
> ## Bug 1: `list_tables()` includes "OK:" as a table name
> 
> **File:** `webcms/database/kosdb_client.py:461-466`
> 
> `SHOW TABLES` on the server returns `"OK:\nsettings"`. The client splits by newline:
> 
> ```python
> def list_tables(self) -> List[str]:
>     result = self.execute("SHOW TABLES")
>     if result.startswith("ERROR"):
>         return []
>   ...
> (truncated, 5524 chars total)

<!-- {"role": "tool", "content": "# KosCMS Database Issues \u2014 Settings Not Persisting\n\nThese bugs were found while debugging why admin/settings changes report success but revert on page refresh.\n\n## Bug 1: `list_tables()` includes \"OK:\" as a table name\n\n**File:** `webcms/database/kosdb_client.py:461-466`\n\n`SHOW TABLES` on the server returns `\"OK:\\nsettings\"`. The client splits by newline:\n\n```python\ndef list_tables(self) -> List[str]:\n    result = self.execute(\"SHOW TABLES\")\n    if result.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n        return []\n    return [line.strip() for line in result.split('\\n') if line.strip()]\n    # Returns: [\"OK:\", \"settings\"]  <-- \"OK:\" is a phantom table\n```\n\nThis works by accident for `\"settings\" in tables` in `_ensure_settings_table_kosdb()`, but is fragile.\n\n**Fix:**\n```python\ndef list_tables(self) -> List[str]:\n    result = self.execute(\"SHOW TABLES\")\n    if result.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n        return []\n    return [line.strip() for line in result.split('\\n')\n            if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith(\"OK\")]\n```\n\n---\n\n## Bug 2: INSERT/UPDATE results never checked for errors\n\n**File:** `webcms/admin/admin_api.py:1263-1295`\n\nIn `update_settings()`, the result of each `self.db.execute(cmd)` is printed but never inspected:\n\n```python\nresult = self.db.execute(cmd)\nprint(f\"[DEBUG] Execute result: {result}\")\n# If result is \"ERROR: No database selected\" \u2014 still returns {\"updated\": true}\n```\n\n**Fix:** Collect errors and return them:\n```python\nerrors = []\nfor key, value in normalized.items():\n    # ... existing check/insert/update logic ...\n    result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n    if result and (\"ERROR\" in result or \"No database\" in result):\n        errors.append({\"key\": key, \"error\": result})\n\nif errors:\n    return Response.json({\"updated\": False, \"errors\": errors, \"settings\": data}, 400)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Bug 3: Pool re-sends `USE` on every acquire (triggers KosDB race condition)\n\n**File:** `webcms/database/kosdb_client.py:331-332`\n\nEvery time a connection is taken from the pool, it re-sends `USE webcms`:\n\n```python\n@contextmanager\ndef acquire(self):\n    # ...\n    if self.config.database:\n        conn.execute(f\"USE {self.config.database}\")  # <-- triggers use_database() on server every time\n    yield conn\n```\n\nThis is the direct trigger of the KosDB thread-safety bug (see KOSDB_ISSUES.md Bug #1). Each `USE` call closes and reopens the shared `_db` handle on the server.\n\n**Fix:** Only send `USE` on new connections, not on every acquire:\n```python\nclass KosDBConnection:\n    def __init__(self, config):\n        # ...\n        self._db_selected = False\n\n    def connect(self) -> bool:\n        # ... existing connect logic ...\n        self._db_selected = False  # reset on reconnect\n        return True\n\n    def _select_database(self, database: str) -> bool:\n        result = self.execute(f\"USE {database}\")\n        self._db_selected = result.startswith(\"OK\")\n        return self._db_selected\n\n# In pool acquire():\n@contextmanager\ndef acquire(self):\n    # ...\n    if self.config.database and not conn._db_selected:\n        conn.execute(f\"USE {self.config.database}\")\n    yield conn\n```\n\n---\n\n## Bug 4: Port mismatch in config\n\n**File:** `config.json:6`\n\nConfig says port `5555`, but KosDB server runs on `5556`.\n\n```json\n\"port\": 5555   <-- should be 5556\n```\n\n**Fix:** Change to `\"port\": 5556`.\n\n---\n\n## Bug 5: Stale version across multiple files\n\n`AUTOVERSION.py` is at `1.3.29` but several files have old versions:\n\n| File | Current | Should be |\n|------|---------|-----------|\n| `README.md:3` | 1.3.6 | 1.3.29 (already fixed) |\n| `setup.py:12` | 1.0.0 | 1.3.29 |\n| `pyproject.toml:7` | 1.2.0 | 1.3.29 |\n\n**Fix:** Update all to match `AUTOVERSION.py` (currently `1.3.29`).\n\n---\n\n## Bug 6: `setup.py` and `requirements.txt` reference Flask \u2014 wrong framework\n\n**Files:** `setup.py:21-29`, `requirements.txt:3-8`\n\nBoth list Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-JWT-Extended, Flask-CORS as dependencies. But the project uses its own framework (`webcms.core.application`, `webcms.core.request`, `webcms.core.response`) \u2014 **not Flask**. These dependencies are dead weight and may cause confusion.\n\n**Fix:** Update `requirements.txt` to list actual dependencies (plyvel, etc.) and remove Flask references. Update `setup.py` accordingly.\n\n---\n\n## Bug 7: `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml` reference Flask\n\n**Files:** `Dockerfile:9-10,45`, `docker-compose.yml:13`\n\n- `Dockerfile` sets `FLASK_APP=run.py` and runs gunicorn \u2014 but the app uses its own server via `run.py` calling `app.run()`\n- `docker-compose.yml` sets `DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///` \u2014 but the app uses KosDB\n\n**Fix:** Update Dockerfile CMD to `CMD [\"python\", \"run.py\", \"--host\", \"0.0.0.0\", \"--port\", \"8080\"]` and update docker-compose environment to use KosDB config.\n\n---\n\n## Summary\n\n| # | File | Issue | Severity | Also needs |\n|---|------|-------|----------|------------|\n| 1 | `kosdb_client.py:461` | `list_tables()` returns \"OK:\" as table | Low | - |\n| 2 | `admin_api.py:1294` | INSERT/UPDATE errors silently swallowed | High | - |\n| 3 | `kosdb_client.py:331` | Pool re-sends USE on every acquire | **Critical** | KOSDB_ISSUES.md Bug #1 |\n| 4 | `config.json:6` | Wrong port (5555 vs 5556) | High | - |\n| 5 | `README.md`, `setup.py`, `pyproject.toml` | Stale versions | Low | - |\n| 6 | `setup.py`, `requirements.txt` | Flask deps \u2014 wrong framework | Medium | - |\n| 7 | `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml` | Flask refs \u2014 wrong framework | Medium | - |\n\n**Bug #3 + KosDB Bug #1 together are the root cause** of the settings not persisting. Fix both sides.\n", "sessionId": 344, "rowId": 169, "timestamp": 1784401927.1957326, "date": "2026-07-18", "name": "ReadFile"} -->

if isinstance(user, dict) else None)\n        return None\n\n    def _normalize_page_payload(self, data: dict, request: Request) -> dict:\n        payload = {\n            \"title\": KosDB User/Role Helpers ----------------\n\n    def _ensure_user_roles_kosdb(self):\n        if not self.db or not self._is_kosdb():\n            return\n        try:\n            tables = self.db.list_tables()\n        except Exception:\n            tables = []\n        if 'user_roles' not in tables:\n            try:\n                self.db.execute(\n                    \"CREATE TABLE user_roles (user_id VARCHAR(36), role_id VARCHAR(36))\"\n                )\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n\n    def _get_user_role_names_kosdb(self, user_id: str) -> list:\n        if not self.db or not self._is_kosdb():\n            return []\n        self._ensure_user_roles_kosdb()\n        cmd = f\"SELECT role_id FROM user_roles WHERE user_id='{self._sql_escape(user_id)}'\"\n        result = self.db.query(cmd)\n        if result.get('error'):\n            return []\n        role_ids = [row.get('role_id') for row in result.get('rows', []) if row.get('role_id')]\n        if not role_ids:\n            return []\n        ids_str = \", \".join(f\"'{self._sql_escape(rid)}'\" for rid in role_ids)\n        cmd = f\"SELECT name FROM roles WHERE id IN ({ids_str})\"\n        result = self.db.query(cmd)\n        if result.get('error'):\n            return []\n        return [row.get('name') for row in result.get('rows', []) if row.get('name')]\n\n    def _set_user_roles_kosdb(self, user_id: str, role_names: list):\n        if not self.db or not self._is_kosdb():\n            return\n        self._ensure_user_roles_kosdb()\n        if not role_names:\n            return\n        ids = self._role_names_to_ids_kosdb(role_names)\n        for rid in ids:\n            self.db.execute(\n                f\"INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) VALUES \"\n                f\"('{self._sql_escape(user_id)}', '{self._sql_escape(rid)}')\"\n            )\n\n    def _ensure_roles_kosdb(self):\n        if not self.db or not self._is_kosdb():\n            return\n        try:\n            tables = self.db.list_tables()\n            if 'roles' in tables:\n                return\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        try:\n            self.db.execute(\n                \"CREATE TABLE roles (id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50), \"\n                \"description VARCHAR(255), permissions TEXT, is_default INTEGER DEFAULT 0, \"\n                \"created_at VARCHAR(32), updated_at VARCHAR(32))\"\n            )\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    def _role_names_to_ids_kosdb(self, role_names: list) -> list:\n        if not role_names:\n            return []\n        names = [self._sql_escape(n) for n in role_names]\n        names_str = \", \".join(f\"'{n}'\" for n in names)\n        cmd = f\"SELECT id, name FROM roles WHERE name IN ({names_str})\"\n        result = self.db.query(cmd)\n        return [row.get('id') for row in ---------------- KosDB Content Helpers ----------------\n\n    def _ensure_table_kosdb(self, table_name: str, columns: list):\n        \"\"\"Create a KosDB table if it does not exist.\"\"\"\n        if not self.db:\n            return\n        try:\n            tables = self.db.list_tables()\n            if table_name in tables:\n                return\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        try:\n            self.db.execute(f\"CREATE TABLE {table_name} ({', '.join(columns)})\")\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    def _now_iso(self) -> str:\n        return datetime.utcnow().isoformat()\n\n    def _create_record_kosdb(self, table_name: str, fields: dict) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Insert a new record into a KosDB table and return it.\"\"\"\n        record_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        now = self._now_iso()\n        fields['id'] = record_id\n        fields.setdefault('created_at', now)\n        fields.setdefault('updated_at', now)\n        fields.setdefault('is_deleted', 0)\n        cols = list(fields.keys())\n        vals = [fields[c] for c in cols]\n        val_str = \", \".join(\n            \"NULL\" if v is None else f\"'{self._sql_escape(v)}'\" for v in vals\n        )\n        cmd = f\"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({', '.join(cols)}) VALUES ({val_str})\"\n        result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n        if result.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n            raise RuntimeError(result)\n        return fields\n\n    def _update_record_kosdb(self, table_name: str, record_id: str, fields: dict) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Update a KosDB record and return the updated row.\"\"\"\n        if not fields:\n            result = self.db.query(f\"SELECT * FROM {table_name} WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}'\")\n            rows = result.get('rows', [])\n            return rows[0] if rows else {}\n        fields['updated_at'] = self._now_iso()\n        sets = []\n        for k, v in fields.items():\n            if v is None:\n                sets.append(f\"{k}=NULL\")\n            else:\n                sets.append(f\"{k}='{self._sql_escape(v)}'\")\n        cmd = (\n            f\"UPDATE {table_name} SET {', '.join(sets)} \"\n            f\"WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}' AND is_deleted='0'\"\n        )\n        result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n        if result.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n            raise RuntimeError(result)\n        result = self.db.query(f\"SELECT * FROM {table_name} WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}'\")\n        rows = result.get('rows', [])\n        return rows[0] if rows else fields\n\n    def _delete_record_kosdb(self, table_name: str, record_id: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Soft-delete a KosDB record.\"\"\"\n        cmd = (\n            f\"UPDATE {table_name} SET is_deleted='1', updated_at='{self._now_iso()}' \"\n            f\"WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}' AND is_deleted='0'\"\n        )\n        result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n        return not result.startswith(\"ERROR\")\n\n    def _resolve_author_display(self, record) -> any:\n        \"\"\"Resolve author display name from an ORM object or dict record.\"\"\"\n        author_id = None\n        if isinstance(record, dict):\n            author = record.get('author')\n            if isinstance(author, dict):\n                return author.get('display_name')\n            author_id = record.get('author_id')\n        else:\n            author = getattr(record, 'author', None)\n            if author:\n                return getattr(author, 'display_name', None)\n            author_id = getattr(record, 'author_id', None)\n        if author_id and self.db:\n            try:\n                from webcms.models.user import User\n                user = self._get_model_by_id(User, author_id)\n                if isinstance(user, dict):\n                    return user.get('display_name') or user.get('username')\n                if user:\n                    return getattr(user, 'display_name', None) or getattr(user, 'username', None)\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n        return author_id\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format_updated_at(value) -> any:\n        if value is None:\n            return None\n        if isinstance(value, datetime):\n            return value.isoformat()\n        return value\n\n    def _split_csv(self, value) -> list:\n        if isinstance(value, list):\n            return value\n        if isinstance(value, str):\n            return [v.strip() for v in value.split(',') if v.strip()]\n        return []\n\n    # ---------------- Content: Pages & Posts ----------------\n\n    def _serialize_page(self, page) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"id\": page.get('id') if \"author\": self._resolve_author_display(post),\n            \"updated_at\": (\n                self._format_updated_at(post.get('updated_at')) if isinstance(post, dict)\n                else    self._ensure_table_kosdb(table_name, columns)\n\n    def _current_user_id(self, request: Request) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Extract current user id from auth or request context if available.\"\"\"\n if isinstance(user, dict) else None)\n        return None\n\n    def _normalize_page_payload(self, data: dict, request: Request) -> dict:\n        payload = {\n            \"title\": self._kosdb_where_clause(k, v) for k, v in filters.items()\n            )\n            cmd = f\"SELECT * FROM {table_name} WHERE {where}\"\n            result = self.db.query(cmd)\n            if result.get('error'):\n                return None\n            rows = result.get('rows', [])\n            return rows[0] if rows else None\n        else:\n            query = self.db.query(model_class)\n            for key, value in filters.items():\n                query = query.filter(getattr(model_class, key) == value)\n            return query.first()\n\n    # ---------------- Dashboard ----------------\n\n    def dashboard(self, request: Request) -> Response:\n        from webcms.models.user import User\n        from webcms.models.content import Post, Page\n        from webcms.models.media import Media\n        stats = {}\n        if self.db:\n            stats = {\n                \"users\": {\n                    \"total\": self._get_model_count(User, {\"is_deleted\": False}),\n                    \"active\": self._get_model_count(User, {\"is_deleted\": False, \"is_active\": True})\n                },\n                \"content\": {\n                    \"posts\": self._get_model_count(Post, {\"is_deleted\": False}),\n                    \"pages\": self._get_model_count(Page, {\"is_deleted\": False})\n                },\n                \"media\": {\n                    \"total\": self._get_model_count(Media, {\"is_deleted\": False})\n                }\n            }\n        widgets = [\n            {\"id\": \"stats\", \"title\": \"Content Statistics\", \"icon\": \"\ud83d\udcca\", \"data\": stats},\n            {\"id\": \"activity\", \"title\": \"Recent Activity\", \"icon\": \"\ud83d\udcc5\", \"data\": {\"recent_posts\": stats.get(\"content\", {}).get(\"posts\", 0)}},\n            {\"id\": \"health\", \"title\": \"System Health\", \"icon\": \"\u2764\ufe0f\", \"data\": {\"status\": \"ok\"}}\n        ]\n        for widget in widgets:\n            widget.setdefault(\"icon\", \"\")\n            widget.setdefault(\"data\", \"\")\n        return Response.json({\"widgets\": widgets})\n\n    # ---------------- KosDB Content Helpers ----------------\n\n    def _ensure_table_kosdb(self, table_name: str, columns: list):\n        \"\"\"Create a KosDB table if it does not exist.\"\"\"\n        if not self.db:\n            return\n        try:\n            tables = self.db.list_tables()\n            if table_name in tables:\n                return\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        try:\n            self.db.execute(f\"CREATE TABLE {table_name} ({', '.join(columns)})\")\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    def _now_iso(self) -> str:\n        return datetime.utcnow().isoformat()\n\n    def _create_record_kosdb(self, table_name: str, fields: dict) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Insert a new record into a KosDB table and return it.\"\"\"\n        record_id = str(uuid.uuid4())\n        now = self._now_iso()\n        fields['id'] = record_id\n        fields.setdefault('created_at', now)\n        fields.setdefault('updated_at', now)\n        fields.setdefault('is_deleted', 0)\n        cols = list(fields.keys())\n        vals = [fields[c] for c in cols]\n        val_str = \", \".join(\n            \"NULL\" if v is None else f\"'{self._sql_escape(v)}'\" for v in vals\n        )\n        cmd = f\"INSERT INTO {table_name} ({', '.join(cols)}) VALUES ({val_str})\"\n        result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n        if result.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n            raise RuntimeError(result)\n        return fields\n\n    def _update_record_kosdb(self, table_name: str, record_id: str, fields: dict) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Update a KosDB record and return the updated row.\"\"\"\n        if not fields:\n            result = self.db.query(f\"SELECT * FROM {table_name} WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}'\")\n            rows = result.get('rows', [])\n            return rows[0] if rows else {}\n        fields['updated_at'] = self._now_iso()\n        sets = []\n        for k, v in fields.items():\n            if v is None:\n                sets.append(f\"{k}=NULL\")\n            else:\n                sets.append(f\"{k}='{self._sql_escape(v)}'\")\n        cmd = (\n            f\"UPDATE {table_name} SET {', '.join(sets)} \"\n            f\"WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}' AND is_deleted='0'\"\n        )\n        result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n        if result.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n            raise RuntimeError(result)\n        result = self.db.query(f\"SELECT * FROM {table_name} WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}'\")\n        rows = result.get('rows', [])\n        return rows[0] if rows else fields\n\n    def _delete_record_kosdb(self, table_name: str, record_id: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Soft-delete a KosDB record.\"\"\"\n        cmd = (\n            f\"UPDATE {table_name} SET is_deleted='1', updated_at='{self._now_iso()}' \"\n            f\"WHERE id='{self._sql_escape(record_id)}' AND is_deleted='0'\"\n        )\n        result = self.db.execute(cmd)\n        return not result.startswith(\"ERROR\")\n\n    def _resolve_author_display(self, record) -> any:\n        \"\"\"Resolve author display name from an ORM object or dict record.\"\"\"\n        author_id = None\n        if isinstance(record, dict):\n            author = record.get('author')\n            if isinstance(author, dict):\n                return author.get('display_name')\n            author_id = record.get('author_id')\n        else:\n            author = getattr(record, 'author', None)\n            if author:\n                return getattr(author, 'display_name', None)\n            author_id = getattr(record, 'author_id', None)\n        if author_id and self.db:\n            try:\n                from webcms.models.user import User\n                user = self._get_model_by_id(User, author_id)\n                if isinstance(user, dict):\n                    return user.get('display_name') or user.get('username')\n                if user:\n                    return getattr(user, 'display_name', None) or getattr(user, 'username', None)\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n        return author_id\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format_updated_at(value) -> any:\n        if value is None:\n            return None\n        if isinstance(value, datetime):\n            return value.isoformat()\n        return value\n\n    def _split_csv(self, value) -> list:\n        if isinstance(value, list):\n            return value\n        if isinstance(value, str):\n            return [v.strip() for v in value.split(',') if v.strip()]\n        return []\n\n    # ---------------- Content: Pages & Posts ----------------\n\n    def _serialize_page(self, page) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"id\": page.get('id') if page.slug,\n            \"status\": page.get('status') if isinstance(page, dict) else page.status,\n            \"author\": self._resolve_author_display(page),\n            \"updated_at\": (\n                self._format_updated_at(page.get('updated_at')) if isinstance(page, dict)\n                else self._format_updated_at(page.updated_at)\n            )\n        }\n\n    def \"author\": self._resolve_author_display(post),\n            \"updated_at\": (\n                self._format_updated_at(post.get('updated_at')) if isinstance(post, dict)\n                else    self._ensure_table_kosdb(table_name, columns)\n\n    def _current_user_id(self, request: Request) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Extract current user id from auth or request context if available.\"\"\"\n if isinstance(user, dict) else None)\n        return None\n\n    def _normalize_page_payload(self, data: dict, request: Request) -> dict:\n        payload = {\n            \"title\": data.get(\"title\", \"Untitled\"),\n            \"slug\": data.get(\"slug\", \"\"),\n            \"content\": data.get(\"content\", \"\"),\n            \"status\": data.get(\"status\", \"draft\"),\n self._current_user_id(request) or \"\",\n            \"excerpt\": data.get(\"excerpt\"),\n            \"meta_title\": data.get(\"meta_title\"),\n            \"meta_description\":  user_response = self._receive()\n            \n            if not user_response.startswith(\"OK\"):\n                logger.error(f\"Auth failed: {login_response} / {user_response}\")\n                return False\n            \n            self._send(f\"PASS {self.config.password}\")\n            pass_response = self._receive()\n            \n            if pass_response.startswith(\"OK\"):\n                self.authenticated = True\n                logger.debug(f\"Authenticated as {self.config.username}\")\n                return True\n            else:\n                logger.error(f\"Authentication failed: {pass_response}\")\n                return False\n                \n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"Authentication error: {e}\")\n            return False\n    \n    def _select_database(self, database: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Select database.\"\"\"\n        result = self.execute(f\"USE {database}\")\n        self._db_selected self.socket.sendall(command.encode() + b'\\n')\n    \n    def _receive(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Receive full response from server.\"\"\"\n        if not self.socket:\n            return \"ERROR: socket.timeout:\n                    break\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        finally:\n            self.socket.settimeout(self.config.query_timeout)\n        \n        return string\n        \n        Returns:\n            Server response string\n        \"\"\"\n        with self.lock:\n            if not self.connected:\n                if not self.connect():\n Parsed results as dict with columns and rows\n        \"\"\"\n        response = self.execute(command)\n        \n        if response.startswith(\"ERROR\"):\n            return {\"error\": response, \"\"\"Create initial connections.\"\"\"\n        for _ in range(self.config.pool_size):\n            conn = KosDBConnection(self.config)\n            if conn.connect():\n                self.pool.put(conn)\n                logger.debug(\"Added connection to pool\")\n    \n    @contextmanager\n    def acquire(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Acquire connection from pool.\n        \n
